{"command": "python3 -c "
import cv2
import numpy as np

img65 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0065.png')
# At each column c from 160 to 220, where is the floor-wall boundary, and where does the sofa touch the floor?
# Floor color: BGR ~ [113-135, 126-150, 132-158] (note: red > green > blue)
# Sofa color: BGR ~ [117-125, 109-115, 104-110] (blue > green > red)
# Wall color: [255, 255, 255]

for c in range(160, 220, 5):
    col = img65[:, c]
    # find all sofa rows
    diff = col[:, 0].astype(int) - col[:, 2].astype(int)
    sofa_r = np.where((diff > 5) & (col[:, 0] > 90) & (col[:, 0] < 160))[0]
    # find wall-floor boundary:
    wall_r = np.where((col[:, 0] > 240) & (col[:, 1] > 240) & (col[:, 2] > 240))[0]
    floor_r = np.where((col[:, 2] > col[:, 0] + 5) & (col[:, 0] > 100))[0]
    print(f'c={c}: sofa=[{sofa_r.min() if len(sofa_r)>0 else None}, {sofa_r.max() if len(sofa_r)>0 else None}], wall_max={wall_r.max() if len(wall_r)>0 else None}, floor_min={floor_r.min() if len(floor_r)>0 else None}')
"", "description": "Trace wall-floor and sofa contacts in obs_0065"}

{"command": "python3 -c "
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

arr14 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0014.png').convert('RGB'))
arr15 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0015.png').convert('RGB'))

# Sofa mask
def get_sofa(arr):
    return (arr[:, :, 0] > 90) & (arr[:, :, 0] < 130) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 100) & (arr[:, :, 1] < 140) & (arr[:, :, 2] > 110) & (arr[:, :, 2] < 150)

m14 = get_sofa(arr14)
m15 = get_sofa(arr15)

y14, x14 = np.where(m14)
y15, x15 = np.where(m15)

print(f'obs14: x=[{x14.min()}, {x14.max()}], y=[{y14.min()}, {y14.max()}], width={x14.max()-x14.min()}, height={y14.max()-y14.min()}')
print(f'obs15: x=[{x15.min()}, {x15.max()}], y=[{y15.min()}, {y15.max()}], width={x15.max()-x15.min()}, height={y15.max()-y15.min()}')

# Triangulation from forward movement of 0.5m:
# w14 = f * W / d14
# w15 = f * W / (d14 - 0.5)
# w15 / w14 = d14 / (d14 - 0.5)
# Let's compute:
w14 = x14.max() - x14.min()
w15 = x15.max() - x15.min()
ratio = w15 / w14
d14 = 0.5 * ratio / (ratio - 1)
print(f'd14 = {d14:.3f} m, d15 = {d14 - 0.5:.3f} m')
print(f'Width of sofa W = {w14 * d14 / 256:.3f} m')
# Sofa center x-coord in world:
# at obs14, camera is at x=0.0, y=1.0, facing +x.
# Sofa is at x = d14, y = 1.0 + lateral_offset
center_col_14 = (x14.min() + x14.max()) / 2.0
lat_14 = (center_col_14 - 255.5) / 256.0 * d14
# In obs14 (facing +x), camera right is -y!
# So y_world = 1.0 - lat_14
print(f'Sofa center: x={d14:.3f}, y={1.0 - lat_14:.3f}')
"", "description": "Triangulate sofa position from obs 14 and 15"}
